outdir.description: Directory for execution reports and published results.

mode.description: Which pipeline to run: 'bacterial' (GTDB), 'viral' (NCBI Virus by default, BV-BRC via --source) or 'reads' (ENA/SRA sequencing runs assembled per run).

stage_options.title: Per-stage arguments
stage_options.description: Argument strings passed through to each repgenr CLI stage.

metadata_args.description: Arguments for the bacterial metadata stage (GTDB selection). Reaches the process as task.ext.args; a site config can override it with withName.

vmetadata_args.description: Arguments for the viral metadata stage (NCBI Virus by default, BV-BRC via --source bvbrc). Reaches the process as task.ext.args; a site config can override it with withName.

vgenome_args.description: Arguments for the viral genome selection stage. Reaches the process as task.ext.args; a site config can override it with withName.

phylo_args.description: Arguments for the phylogeny stage (aligner, tree builder, rooting with --root outgroup|midpoint|none). Reaches the process as task.ext.args; a site config can override it with withName. With --root midpoint, TREE2TAX receives --keep-root.

phylo_split_msa.description: Run the alignment and the tree as separate tasks.
phylo_split_msa.help_text: The alignment then survives a change of tree builder or bootstrap, and the two halves request their own resources. Only for tree builders that consume an alignment; leave it off for mashtree or sourmash.

sketch.description: Sketch the genomes with sourmash and give the sketches to the dereplication and tree tasks.
sketch.help_text: Bacterial path only. Writes sketches/<record name>.sig.zip (k=21, 31 and 51 at scaled=1000) for every genome and the outgroup, publishes the directory, and stages it into the dereplication and tree tasks. A sourmash dereplicator or tree builder then reads the sketches instead of sketching; other tools ignore them. Needs sourmash.

annotator.description: Annotator for the core-gene route (phylo_args with --msa-source coregene).
annotator.help_text: Bacterial and reads paths. ANNOTATE runs it once per representative genome, and for the outgroup unless phylo_args has --no-outgroup, and the records are staged into the phylo task as --annotations-dir. Without --msa-source coregene nothing is annotated.

bakta_db.description: bakta database directory (bakta_db download --output DIR --type light), staged into each ANNOTATE task.
bakta_db.help_text: Without it, bakta reads BAKTA_DB from the task environment. Not needed with --annotator prokka. The directory is linked into each task by default; under stageInMode 'copy', or on a cloud executor without a shared file system, it is copied or downloaded once per genome, which for the light database (about 4 GB) is costly; there, give a path the tasks can read directly through BAKTA_DB instead.

annotate_args.description: Extra arguments for repgenr annotate-build, after --tool (for example --tool-arg skip_trna=true). Reaches the process as task.ext.args; a site config can override it with withName.

tree2tax_args.description: Arguments for the tree-to-taxonomy (FlexTaxD) stage. Reaches the process as task.ext.args; a site config can override it with withName.

reads_options.title: Reads mode
reads_options.description: Selection, assembly and quality options for --mode reads.

reads_args.description: Arguments for the reads stage (ENA/SRA run selection by taxon or accession). Reaches READS_SELECT as task.ext.args.

assembler.description: Assembler for every run: 'auto' picks by platform (skesa for Illumina, flye for long reads), or any registered adapter name.

assemble_args.description: Extra flags for assemble-run (for example --min-contig-length or --tool-arg). Reaches READS_ASSEMBLE as task.ext.args after --assembler.

checkm2_db.description: CheckM2 DIAMOND database. When set, GENOME_QC scores every assembly and the gather step excuses those outside the completeness/contamination gate.

gtdb_sketch.description: GTDB sourmash sketch database (.sig.zip). When set, GENOME_QC classifies every assembly and the gather step names genomes by the GTDB tokens where the genus agrees.

gtdb_lineages.description: The lineages CSV published with the GTDB sketch.

reads_sketch.description: Sketch every selected run streamed from the archive (READS_SKETCH, the standalone form of repgenr reads-sketch) and publish the sketches under reads/reads_sketches/. Implied by reads_screen.

reads_sketch_spots.description: Stop the stream of each run after its first N spots (reads-sketch --max-spots); the sketches go to the spots_N variant. Unset sketches the whole run.

reads_screen.description: Judge the sketches against the GTDB sketch before any download (READS_SCREEN, the standalone form of repgenr reads-screen: taxon_mismatch, low_match_fraction, duplicate_isolate) and assemble only the runs of passed.txt. Needs gtdb_sketch and gtdb_lineages as parameters (the REPGENR_GTDB_* environment variables the CLI accepts are not read here).

reads_screen_args.description: Extra flags for reads-screen (--min-fraction, --dup-ani). Reaches READS_SCREEN as task.ext.args after the GTDB paths.

scaling_options.title: Dereplication scaling
scaling_options.description: Two-stage chunking knobs for large dereplication inputs.

derep_process_size.description: Genomes per chunk for the scatter-gather dereplication. Leave unset for a single chunk. (A digit string is accepted so command-line overrides validate.)

derep_tool.description: Dereplicator used by the scatter-gather subworkflow. Any registered adapter name (built-in: skder/drep/galah/sourmash, plus pip-installed plugins); RepGenR2 validates the name at stage start.

derep_primary_ani.description: Primary ANI threshold for the scatter-gather subworkflow (0-1).

derep_secondary_ani.description: Secondary ANI threshold for the scatter-gather subworkflow (0-1).

derep_aligned_fraction.description: Aligned-fraction threshold for the scatter-gather subworkflow (0-1).

derep_keeper.description: Representative choice in the chunk and merge steps: 'quality' picks by the CheckM completeness/contamination in selection.tsv and the genome N50; 'gtdb' keeps a GTDB species representative (selection.tsv column gtdb_representative) and applies the quality rule to clusters without one; both apply only when a selection.tsv reaches the dereplication steps. 'tool' keeps the adapter's own pick.

derep_reduce.description: Taxonomy-aware reduction after the merge: one representative per species or genus. The taxonomy comes from selection.tsv when it reaches the merge step, else from the canonical genome filenames.

derep_target_reps.description: Target representative count for the merge step: the secondary ANI of the merge pass is searched to land near it (0 = off; the merge pass re-runs per search step).

derep_refine.description: Seed genomes of a lineage to keep at finer resolution (comma-separated filenames, stems or accessions): after the merge, every cluster holding a seed is dereplicated again at derep_refine_ani (dereplicate-refine).

derep_refine_ani.description: Secondary ANI for the clusters of the derep_refine seeds; above derep_secondary_ani. (A decimal string is accepted so command-line overrides validate.)

derep_refine_file.description: TSV with the columns seed and ani: several lineages, each refined at its own ANI after the merge.

repgenr_opts.description: Top-level options prepended to every repgenr call (set by container profiles).

help.description: Print a usage message and exit.
